title: Tim Peters, Zen of Python author and Timsort creator, dies
summary: Tim Peters, a Python core developer known for the Zen of Python and the Timsort sorting algorithm, has died; a Python Discourse memorial thread gives his dates as 1952–2026. The thread highlights his influence on Python&\#x27;s design philosophy and standard library. His other noted work includes SpamBayes and the Python Cookbook.
